$schema_note: SENTINEL APEX public-repo zero-trust workflow-permissions allowlist. Generated 2026-09-10 as part of the P0 GitHub Actions least-privilege audit (see tests/test_public_repo_zero_trust_gates.py, TestNoUnexplainedWritePermissions). Every (workflow, job) pair anywhere in .github/workflows/*.yml that resolves to a GITHUB_TOKEN write permission MUST have exactly one entry here. The default contract for everything not listed is permissions: contents: read. A write permission introduced anywhere without a corresponding entry here fails CI.
